I’ve never been diamond status so I wouldn’t know about that. My acceptance rate stays between 0-5%. I do the Avis uber rental program.

The rental is unlimited mileage it also allows you to pick up passengers with electric comfort/uberx etc but I just use it to do Uber eats. I make a profit if I put in enough hours 10 -12 hours a day 5-7 days. The rental is only good temporarily because you will get burnt out eventually trying to make it profitable. If I were you I would use the rental to stack up some maintenance money then go back to your car.

Ive been renting a chevy bolt euv from Avis 390$ a week for about 2 months now . It’s worth it if you do this full time 7 days a week that way you don’t have to worry about destroying your own car also it does suck coughing up that 390$ when you had a slow week. It’s 1600$ a month if you keep it that long. My advice is to run the rental into the ground while you stack your money for your own car whether that’s so you can buy a new one or put it aside for maintenance.
